name: @kamilio/skylight-calendar-agent
description: Unofficial Toolcraft CLI and MCP server for Skylight Calendar

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const file of ['dist/cli.js','dist/mcp.js','dist/http-mcp.js','dist/http-headers.js']) fs.chmodSync(file,0o755)"
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run smoke && npm pack --dry-run >/dev/null
scripts.smoke: node dist/cli.js --help >/dev/null && node scripts/smoke-version.mjs && node scripts/smoke-help.mjs && node scripts/smoke-mcp.mjs && node scripts/smoke-mcp-json.mjs && node scripts/smoke-http-mcp.mjs && node scripts/smoke-oauth-login.mjs && node scripts/smoke-oauth-provider.mjs && node scripts/smoke-oauth-sqlite-store.mjs && node scripts/smoke-subject-services.mjs && node scripts/smoke-sdk.mjs && tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck scripts/smoke-sdk-types.mts && node scripts/smoke-sdk-sweep.mjs && node scripts/smoke-config.mjs && node scripts/smoke-env.mjs && node scripts/smoke-http.mjs && node scripts/smoke-auth.mjs && node scripts/smoke-credential-store.mjs && node scripts/smoke-frame.mjs && node scripts/smoke-local-validation.mjs && node scripts/smoke-public-request.mjs && node scripts/smoke-requests.mjs && node scripts/smoke-partial-failure.mjs && node scripts/smoke-docs.mjs && node scripts/smoke-package.mjs
